visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Compare Neighbours Instead of Searching the Result
visualizerParams.problemDescription: indexOf searches the whole result for every item. Because the array is sorted, comparing each item with its neighbour is enough; use filter. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: In sorted data a duplicate is always equal to the item before it, so each item is compared once with its neighbour instead of scanning the growing result list.
